subject: SynthWave RFP — assurance intake, evidence curation & delivery schedule
messages:
From: Evan Li <evan.li@synthwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Summers <rachel.s@procure.synthwave.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SynthWave RFP — request for SOC 2 / SIG evidence and control mapping

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking a look at our RFP. We're running an expedited assurance review for a potential 2027 vendor onboarding and need the following to complete our security team evaluation: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted acceptable)
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope
- Completed SIG questionnaire or a control crosswalk to our attached RFP (see SynthWave_RFP_Attach.pdf)
- Sample artifacts/proof for key controls: IAM provisioning logs, key rotation evidence, telemetry/telemetry sampling examples, encryption-at-rest samples, and network segmentation diagrams
- Answers to data residency/processing questions for our EU customers (do you support regionally pinned private deployments?)

Can you confirm a point of contact and an estimated delivery timeline? We're hoping to get an initial packet within 10 business days to keep this track moving. We may request a short technical walkthrough if items need clarification.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a call early next week if that helps.

Best,
Evan Li
Procurement Manager | SynthWave Analytics
E: evan.li@synthwave.ai
T: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: SynthWave_RFP_Attach.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@synthwave.ai>
Cc: Rachel Summers <rachel.s@procure.synthwave.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SynthWave RFP — request for SOC 2 / SIG evidence and control mapping

Hi Evan / Rachel,

Thanks — we can absolutely support this. I'm copying our assurance and product security leads to coordinate artifacts and timeline. Proposed approach below (high level):

1) T+2 business days: Initial evidence packet — redacted SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001 cert, completed SIG CSV for the controls you flagged, and a short index document describing where each artifact maps to your questionnaire rows.
2) T+5 business days: Supplementary artifacts — extracts of IAM audit logs, example key rotation logs (redacted timestamps), architecture diagram showing VPC/private deployment options, and sample telemetry snippets.
3) T+8--10 business days: Optional deep-dive call and follow-up items (vulnerability scan results, third-party supplier list, KMS proof-of-rotation snapshots).

We will redact subject-to-contract customer data and anything covered by NDAs. If you need region-specific proofs (EU processing), note that our Private deployment supports region pinning; we'll include architecture notes and configuration snippets for that in packet #2.

Attachments: redwood_synthwave_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) — contains the phased delivery plan and owners.

Can you confirm that timeline works for your evaluation window? I'll assign owners and track responses via the action plan.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Office: +1 650 555 0199

Subject: Re: SynthWave RFP — evidence packet owners and artifacts

Hi team,

I've reviewed the RFP attachment and assigned owners for each artifact. Below are the concrete deliverables and commitments so everyone is aligned: 

Phase 1 (deliver by 2027-05-21):
- redwood_soc2_type2_redacted.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (legal-reviewed redactions) — owner: Marissa Cole
- redwood_iso27001_certificate.pdf — ISO 27001 certificate and scope page — owner: Marissa Cole
- sig_questionnaire_filled.csv — completed SIG CSV with control responses and notes on compensating controls where applicable — owner: Kimberly Park
- index_readme.md (pack index) — short mapping doc listing which files satisfy each SynthWave question — owner: Kimberly Park

Phase 2 (deliver by 2027-05-24):
- arch_diagram_v2.png — network and tenancy diagram showing hosted / dedicated / private options — owner: Product Security (cc'd)
- iam_provisioning_sample.log (redacted) — sample IAM audit lines showing provisioning and deprovisioning events — owner: Security Ops
- kms_rotation_snapshot.csv (redacted timestamps) — evidence of KMS rotation & key identifiers — owner: Infra Security
- telemetry_sample_snippet.json — small tokenized sample showing telemetry schema and retention flags — owner: Observability Team

Notes / constraints:
- Any PRD-level customer data will be redacted. We will not include raw customer payloads.
- Vulnerability scan summaries will be included in the Phase 2 packet; full scan reports require an NDA addendum for sharing.
- For EU-processing proof, we'll include configuration notes and a sample deployment manifest for our Private deployment; full environment screenshots will be available under an NDA or during the deep-dive call.

Attachments to be delivered are listed in the action plan workbook Sergio circulated. Marissa — can you produce the Phase 1 artifacts by Friday EOD PST? I'll coordinate with Security Ops for Phase 2 timing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Assurance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Sergio / Kimberly / Marissa,

Appreciate the clear plan — that timeline works for our procurement window. A couple quick follow-ups before you ship Phase 1: 

- Can you include a short statement confirming whether we can request environment-level logs from a private deployment pinned to EU regions (this is for our legal team)?
- We also need an example of encryption key provenance — a single KMS key lifecycle entry or similar that shows creation, rotation, and deletion metadata (redacted values ok).
- Please reference HubSpot opportunity ID 67890 when you upload artifacts so our Sourcing team can correlate.

If Phase 1 arrives Friday, we'll review and schedule a 30-minute technical call for early next week (Rachel will set the invite). Thanks again — if anything blocks your legal redactions please flag and we'll accept a placeholder to keep timelines.

Best,
Evan Li
Procurement Manager | SynthWave Analytics
